note: Sierra NF campground on the shore of Huntington Lake near the Kaiser Wilderness, under dense fir and pine. Several walk-to tent sites are right on the shore and allow informal boat mooring; RV site 068 is the one nearest the water. Check in at the Vista Recreation kiosk at the marina. Recreation.gov reported ongoing logging in November 2026, with some areas of the campground closed. --Claude
summary: Rancheria (Sierra NF, Huntington Lake): $47 -> $49 (rec.gov; double $97), +$10 extra vehicle; rec.gov some_sites (7 RV sites first-come), 14 nights; season June-Oct (rec.gov 05-22..09-12); 124 sites, 63 take RVs to 40 ft; no hookups; flush+vault, water; pin ~300 m off (on the highway); lakeview upgrade lead (site 068); phone/website given.
